violations.description: Self-hosted runner used on public pull request trigger
violations.evidence: runs-on: self-hosted-ubuntu triggered by pull_request from any branch
violations.recommendation: Avoid using self-hosted runners on workflows triggered by external or untrusted pull requests (pull_request) to prevent arbitrary code execution on the runner host.

violations.description: Secret echoed and processed in CI workflow log
violations.recommendation: Do not print or echo secrets in GitHub Actions workflows. Remove the step or mask/avoid handling raw secrets in plaintext echo commands.

violations.description: Missing tests and no test execution in CI
violations.evidence: No tests exist in the repository and CI workflow runs no test steps
violations.recommendation: Add a test suite for the application and configure CI to execute tests before completing workflow runs.

violations.description: Missing build validation and release pipeline testing
violations.evidence: Build/deploy workflow runs without building the Docker image or running any validation/tests
violations.recommendation: Add build and test validation steps to the CI/CD pipeline before any deployment or release stages.

violations.description: Missing linter or code formatter configuration
violations.evidence: No linter, static analyzer, or formatter (such as ruff, flake8, black, pylint) configured in the project or CI
violations.recommendation: Configure a linter or formatter (like ruff or black) and integrate it into the development workflow or CI.

violations.evidence: flask dependency listed without any version specifier in requirements.txt
violations.recommendation: Pin application dependencies to specific versions or ranges (e.g. flask==2.3.3) to ensure reproducible builds.

violations.evidence: .gitignore only ignores .git directory and fails to ignore standard Python/Docker/IDE artifacts or caches
violations.recommendation: Update .gitignore to properly exclude standard build artifacts, caches (__pycache__), virtual environments, and local environment files.
